title: Committed docs embed absolute local home-dir paths and username
detail: Newly committed docs embed the developer's absolute home-dir paths, username, and an ephemeral worktree path — local-environment disclosure if the repo is ever published, and the worktree path goes stale immediately.
recommended_fix: Replace absolute /Users/moses/... references with repo-relative paths (e.g. _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/packet-plumber-v2-design-audit/, which is committed at repo root) and drop the ephemeral worktree line.
